# AnalyzeResp

The data analysis functions are frequently updated, please make sure you
have the latest version. (July 17, 2025)

## Installation:

The latest version of AnalyzeResp can be installed from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) following:

``` r
install.packages("devtools") # if devtools is not installed
devtools::install_github("kraskura/AnalyzeResp")
library(AnalyzeResp)
```

*The older version of this code was shared with users as one R script*

# Package index

## All functions

- [`MMR()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/MMR.md) :
  Estimates regressions for MMR.
- [`MMR_SMR_AS_EPOC()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/MMR_SMR_AS_EPOC.md)
  : estimates individual specific metabolic rates and recovery
- [`SDA()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/SDA.md) :
  estimates regressions for SDA (digestion) measurements
- [`SMR()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/SMR.md) :
  Estimates regressions for automatically timed measurement cycles
- [`csvSplit()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/csvSplit.md)
  : Function to split to csv files for independent analyses.
- [`organizeAnalysisLocally()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/organizeAnalysisLocally.md)
  : convenient function to create a set of local working directories to
  streamline workflow
- [`slidingSlope()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/slidingSlope.md)
  : steepest slope analysis only
- [`textFileConvert()`](https://kraskura.github.io/AnalyzeResp/reference/textFileConvert.md)
  : filters and converts raw data files
